items.headline: Jackson Arnold has TD pass, TD run to help UNLV hold on for 24-22 victory over San Jose State
items.description: — Jackson Arnold had a touchdown pass and a scoring run to help UNLV hold off San Jose State 24-22 on Saturday in a game that wasn't decided until the Spartans' two-point try failed with 45 seconds remaining.

items.headline: Air Force rides Kemper Hodges, Evan Medders to 24-3 victory over San Jose State
items.description: — Kemper Hodges finished with two touchdown runs and Evan Medders added an 81-yarder to end a dominant second quarter as Air Force rolled to a 24-3 victory over San Jose State on Saturday night.
